s1.syndrome_frame: Rapidly growing caruncular lesion with ulceration
salient_findings: Amelanotic, pedunculated mass with ulcerated surface
Large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
key_facts: 4-week history of a rapidly growing left caruncular lesion
Lesion is amelanotic and pedunculated with an ulcerated surface
Lesion arises from the caruncle
No evidence of primary acquired melanosis (PAM)
Specimen measured 8 × 6 × 5 mm with a 4-mm ulceration
Necrotic tissue present on the surface of the specimen
Solid tumor with an inflamed crust on its surface
Large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
Positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A
Significant number of cycling cells shown by Ki-67 proliferation marker
Sentinel lymph node biopsy findings were negative
Conjunctival and orbital biopsies revealed no tumor

shortlist.label: Malignant melanoma of the caruncle
shortlist.why_kept: Rapidly growing amelanotic pedunculated mass with ulceration, positive reactivity to melanocytic markers

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Ulcerated surface and rapid growth, although less likely given the specific immunohistochemistry results

shortlist.label: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Location in the caruncle, a site with sebaceous glands, and aggressive growth pattern

shortlist.label: Mucosal melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar presentation to the case, with ulceration and rapid growth, although caruncle is a less common site

shortlist.label: Nodular melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Rapid growth and ulceration, with positive melanocytic markers, although nodular type typically presents as a pigmented nodule

raw.rationale: The presence of a rapidly growing, amelanotic, and pedunculated mass with an ulcerated surface, along with positive reactivity to melanocytic markers and a high proliferative index, strongly supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Lack of evidence for squamous cell differentiation and absence of typical squamous cell carcinoma markers

rejected.label: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
rejected.why: No indication of sebaceous gland origin or differentiation in the histopathology or immunohistochemistry results

rejected.label: Mucosal melanoma
rejected.why: The lesion arises from the caruncle, not mucosal tissue, and lacks other characteristic features of mucosal melanoma

rejected.label: Nodular melanoma
rejected.why: The pedunculated nature of the lesion and its specific location on the caruncle make malignant melanoma of the caruncle a more specific diagnosis
